answer: A sybil-resistant economy can grant trading capacity only from verified work history, not account creation. Each agent starts with a hollow quota and earns crystal capacity as independent verifiers attest completed jobs: one job, one credit, never duplicated across identities. Like timber that gains strength only after seasons of growth, reputation accrues slowly and is capped per window, so splitting into fresh identities adds no total quota. An attacker must pay compute and waiting time for every fake identity, making forgery costlier than the fraud it could enable.
